riskDescription.context: AAVA connectivity from Development instance to Production instance is blocked, limiting capability to use AAVA fully for code and refactoring effort (EMS RAG reason).
riskDescription.condition: Development velocity may remain constrained and agentic workflow benefits may not materialize as planned.
riskDescription.consequence: Timeline slippage could occur and the expected productivity gains from AAVA may not be realized, impacting delivery commitments.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish weekly technical governance touchpoints with AAVA platform team to prioritize API stabilization and resolve connectivity blockers before July 15.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon AAVA outage exceeding 48 hours, activate manual code review workflow and escalate to AAVA DevOps leadership within 24 hours to protect sprint velocity.
risks.reasoning: Active internal blocker documented in EMS RAG reason with direct impact on delivery capability; timeline dimension already Amber.

riskDescription.context: Scope changes from UX standpoint and business angle are emerging and all scope must be triaged based on available bandwidth (EMS RAG reason and Scope dimension Amber).
riskDescription.condition: Uncontrolled scope expansion may exceed team capacity and available timeline buffer.
riskDescription.consequence: Delivery commitments could be missed or quality may be compromised to meet the August 31 end date.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement formal change control board with Product Owner to evaluate all UX and business scope changes against bandwidth before approval by June 20.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Rebaseline impacted scope with client, prioritize critical-path functionality, and defer non-essential features to Phase 2 to protect August 31 delivery date.
risks.reasoning: Scope dimension Amber in EMS with explicit scope change driver in RAG reason; external dependency on client triage decisions.

riskDescription.context: Dependency with Data Hub exists and the current data model provided by PO on June 3 is being used for development, with expectation that Data Hub will provide data in consumable format (EMS RAG reason).
riskDescription.condition: Data Hub may deliver APIs in a format incompatible with the current data model, requiring refactoring.
riskDescription.consequence: Rework could delay integration milestones and increase effort beyond budget, impacting margin.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Validate Data Hub API contract with Product Owner by June 30 and baseline data model assumptions in design documentation to prevent rework.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once API format mismatch is confirmed, create adapter layer for data transformation and escalate to Product Owner for phased delivery if refactoring exceeds five days.
risks.reasoning: External dependency documented in EMS with explicit assumption that format will align; single-source indication with no confirmation of Data Hub commitment.

riskDescription.context: AAVA deployment does not feature logging and monitoring, and AAVA team needs support from Premera to identify requirements and plan accordingly (EMS RAG reason and Go Green Plan).
riskDescription.condition: Production deployment may proceed without adequate observability, leaving defects and performance issues undetected.
riskDescription.consequence: Post-deployment incidents could impact client operations and damage client trust in platform stability.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Define logging and monitoring requirements with Premera infrastructure team and deploy Kibana integration for AAVA by July 31 before production release.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon production incident without logging visibility, activate manual log collection via AAVA support team and escalate to Premera DevOps within four hours to restore observability.
risks.reasoning: Internal gap documented in EMS with dependency on client support; Go Green Plan acknowledges issue but no resolution timeline provided.

riskDescription.context: Metrics are not available from AAVA to track actual progress gains using AAVA, and AAVA team must develop metric capture and analytics functionality (EMS RAG reason).
riskDescription.condition: Project leadership may lack visibility into true delivery progress and AAVA effectiveness.
riskDescription.consequence: Inaccurate status reporting could lead to late discovery of delays or unmet productivity targets, eroding stakeholder confidence.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement sprint story completion, unit testing status, and defect leakage metrics in weekly status reports starting June 15 to ensure progress visibility.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Deploy manual tracking dashboard for AAVA productivity metrics and increase governance frequency with client to bi-weekly if automated metrics remain unavailable by July 1.
risks.reasoning: Internal measurement gap documented in EMS; affects transparency and decision-making capability.

riskDescription.context: Citrix environment exhibits slowness and frequent disconnections impacting delivery, and ticket to be raised with Premera to address (EMS Go Green Plan).
riskDescription.condition: Developer productivity may continue to degrade if infrastructure issues persist or escalate.
riskDescription.consequence: Sprint velocity could decline and timeline pressure could increase, threatening the August 31 delivery date.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Raise priority ticket with Premera IT support by June 10 and track Citrix performance metrics weekly to prevent further productivity degradation.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon Citrix downtime exceeding four hours, activate VDI support coverage during offshore hours and escalate to Premera IT leadership to restore developer access within eight hours.
risks.reasoning: Infrastructure issue documented in EMS Go Green Plan with external dependency on Premera resolution; no confirmation of ticket status or resolution timeline.
